description: Water-quality sample results within a radius of a latitude/longitude — the "is the water near me tested, and what did it say" tool. Returns measured values with their station, date and unit. Sourced from the USGS/EPA Water Quality Portal.

characteristicName.description: Analyte name, e.g. "pH", "Nitrate", "Lead". Strongly recommended — an unfiltered radius query is very large.

longitude.description: Decimal degrees, WGS84 (negative in the US)

name: wqp_results_near_point
title: Wqp Results Near Point
